origins.text: A foundling of Blue-stone Village with a sister who is not blood: the headman's other orphan, who has decided you are hers.
Fallen-Star Town's herbalist took you in at seven and has taught you the smell of every leaf on his shelves. You can already refine a pill.
The last of a ruined line, with a draughty manor, an unpaid steward, a good education and a rusted family sword.
You sleep under the Fallen-Star gate. A one-armed drunk shares his gourd and his lessons, and does not say why.
Left in a props-box by a travelling opera, raised on cheap applause, and watched over by a fox you could swear is smiling.
You keep the hill of stones above Blue-stone, where a grey clerk once walked past you without seeing you, and you have been counting ever since.
